source: actual TSX form methods and actual lifetime/lock/cooldown hook
cases: actual form scope synchronously locks send and submit until the active request finishes
cooldown uses an absolute 60-second deadline rather than input contents or decrement-only timers
route change, token replacement and unmount invalidate late responses; cleanup aborts the actual request signal
mismatched reset passwords never send a reset request
duplicate reset-code clicks send once and show a fixed non-enumerating response
reset errors use safe fixed feedback and never echo passwords or codes
late reset success after leaving the public page cannot clear credentials or navigate the new page
email binding supplies current-password proof and never updates another account after token replacement
successful verified binding updates the stored email state and clears proof inputs
disabled SMTP feature prevents both code and proof/reset POSTs independently of the registration switch
successful reset clears proof inputs and delegates return-to-login without making a login request
